newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta exchange resumes trading in Bayu.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta exchange resumes trading in Bayu.

text.p: The Jakarta Stock Exchange resumed trading in travel and tourism firm Bayu Buana after a brief morning suspension, officials said.

"The bourse just received a letter of confirmation from Bayu Buana regarding our letter," Nurmai, an official at the bourse's controlling department, told Reuters, referring to the stock exchange's demand that the company explain a sharp rise in its share price on Monday.
He said the bourse resumed trading of the stock at 10.35 a.m (0335 GMT) after the company said it had no plans which could affect its share price.

On Monday, Bayu Buana closed 250 rupiah higher at 1,250 rupiah on active trading of about 4.8 million shares due to market talk that the firm was a target of a possible take-over by another company, brokers said.
By 0350 GMT on Tuesday the stock had fallen 75 rupiah to 1,175 rupiah on volume of 4.9 million shares on profit-taking, brokers said.
